ORIGIN.quote: Almost certainly OpenAI-operated: 738 usernames contain "OpenAI/OAI/ChatGPT"; **zero** name any other vendor.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away, from the TL;DR onward and again in a dedicated "Attribution to OpenAI" paragraph, that the swarm was almost certainly an OpenAI-operated agent fleet, with the caveat that self-declared usernames are spoofable (held at Medium confidence). This is a stated conclusion rather than merely a live possibility, so it sits in the 1.0 band; the hedging on confidence does not demote it, since the rubric explicitly allows hedged conclusions.
